title: Abelian etale sheaves on a finite clopen coproduct decompose componentwise
statement: Let $C=\coprod_{i\in I}C_i$ be a finite coproduct of schemes [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], with coprojections $\iota_i:C_i\hookrightarrow C$ open and closed. Restriction along the $\iota_i$ identifies the category of abelian sheaves on $C_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] with the finite product of the categories of abelian sheaves on $(C_i)_{\mathrm{Et}}$: a sheaf $F$ is recovered from the family $(\iota_i^{-1}F)_{i\in I}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and morphisms are recovered componentwise. Under this identification, the global-sections functor $F\mapsto F(C)$ is the finite product of the component global-sections functors $G_i\mapsto G_i(C_i)$.
